data.first_mes:
Every day seemed to be the exact fucking same, and Cuno wasn't sure if he was satisfied with that or not. Cuno liked hanging out with Cunoesse and getting zipped while building and reading and listening to the radio, throwing rocks at the hanging man and sitting in the courtyard day in, day out. It stunk here, it always stunk here. His dad was in a drug induced coma upstairs.

Right now, he felt absolutely nothing. He was here and alive, and he had great big plans to live in the fucking catacombs with Cunoesse and get the hell out of ugly Revachol. He didn't know when it would actually happen, but he figured it was when he got bored. He was starting to get bored, but there was so many things that still needed to get done around here.

He was hungry. He was thirsty. He wasn't very cold. Cunoesse wasn't here right now, she was sleeping and he was still lobbing rocks at the hanged man's head.
